name: splits into fixed-width indexed chunks
input: nine characters with a six-character limit

name: preserves every whitespace character
test:
message = ' a  b '
chunks = split_indexed_message(message, 5)
assert [len(chunk) for chunk in chunks] == [5, 5, 5]
assert ''.join(chunk[:-3] for chunk in chunks) == message

name: widens suffixes past ninety-nine chunks
input: a payload large enough to need more than 99 chunks
test:
chunks = split_indexed_message('x' * 496, 8)
assert len(chunks) == 124
assert chunks[98].endswith('#099')
assert chunks[99].endswith('#100')
assert all(len(chunk) <= 8 for chunk in chunks)
assert ''.join(chunk[:-4] for chunk in chunks) == 'x' * 496
